build.buildCommand: python3 -m ensurepip --upgrade && python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip && python3 -m pip install -r mainProject/requirements.txt

deploy.startCommand: cd mainProject && python3 manage.py migrate --noinput && python3 manage.py collectstatic --noinput && python3 -m gunicorn mainProject.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers 1
